newsitem.title: LEBANON: Three Israeli soldiers wounded in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Three Israeli soldiers wounded in Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were wounded on Thursday in a clash with guerrillas in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said the soldiers were caught in a guerrilla ambush in ad-Dahr Daidaba south of Syrian-controlled Bekaa valley, two km (1.2 mile) north of the Israeli south Lebanon occupation zone.
Six Israeli soldiers have now been killed and 31 wounded in south Lebanon since the beginning of 1997.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed resposibility for the attack.
Hizbollah is fighting to oust 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 allied SLA militia from the 15 km (nine miles)-wide zone.
